tools.name: lexware_get_profile
tools.description: The connected Lexware Office organization: organizationId, company name, the user who created the API key, tax type (net/gross/vatfree), small-business flag (Kleinunternehmer), distance-sales principle and the plan's business features (INVOICING, INVOICING_PRO, BOOKKEEPING). Good first call. GET /v1

tools.name: lexware_list_contacts
tools.description: List customers and vendors, optionally filtered (filters combine with AND). name and email match as case-insensitive substrings (at least 3 characters; _ and % are wildcards). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /v1/contacts.

tools.name: lexware_list_articles
tools.description: List articles (products and services usable as invoice line items), with price, tax rate and unit. Optional exact filters by article number, GTIN or type. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /v1/articles.

tools.name: lexware_list_vouchers
tools.description: Search the voucher list: metadata (id, type, status, number, dates, contact, total and open amount) of sales documents (invoice, quotation, creditnote, orderconfirmation, deliverynote, downpaymentinvoice) and bookkeeping vouchers (salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice, purchasecreditnote).

tools.name: lexware_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id: status (draft/open/paid/voided), line items, totals, tax amounts, payment and shipping conditions, related vouchers. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_quotation
tools.description: Get one quotation by id: status (draft/open/accepted/rejected), expiration date, line items, totals. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/quotations/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_credit_note
tools.description: Get one credit note by id: status, line items, totals, related invoice. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/credit-notes/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_order_confirmation
tools.description: Get one order confirmation by id: status, line items, totals, delivery terms. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/order-confirmations/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_delivery_note
tools.description: Get one delivery note by id: status, line items, shipping conditions. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/delivery-notes/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_down_payment_invoice
tools.description: Get one down payment invoice (Abschlagsrechnung) by id: status, amounts, related closing invoice. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/down-payment-invoices/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_dunning
tools.description: Get one dunning (payment reminder) by id: status, the dunned invoice in relatedVouchers, line items, totals. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/dunnings/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_bookkeeping_voucher
tools.description: Get one bookkeeping voucher (salesinvoice, salescreditnote, purchaseinvoice or purchasecreditnote from the voucher list) by id: status, voucher items with posting category ids, tax amounts, contact, file ids. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/vouchers/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_article
tools.description: Get one article (product or service) by id: title, type, article number, GTIN, unit, net/gross price and tax rate. GET /v1/articles/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact (customer and/or vendor) by id: customer/vendor numbers, company or person, contact persons, addresses, emails, phones, note. Includes lexwareAppUrl, a link that opens it in Lexware Office. GET /v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: lexware_get_payments
tools.description: Payment status of an invoice, credit note, down payment invoice or bookkeeping voucher: open amount, payment status (balanced/openRevenue/openExpense), paid date and the payment items (bank transactions, cash, credit notes, Skonto). Not available for quotations or drafts. GET /v1/payments/{voucherId

tools.name: lexware_list_countries
tools.description: Countries known to Lexware Office with their code, English and German name and tax classification (de, intraCommunity, thirdPartyCountry). GET /v1/countries.

tools.name: lexware_list_payment_conditions
tools.description: The payment conditions configured in Lexware Office (days until due, early-payment discount, label template, which is the organization default). GET /v1/payment-conditions.

tools.name: lexware_list_posting_categories
tools.description: Bookkeeping posting categories (id, name, group, income or outgo, whether a contact is required and split tax rates are allowed), used by bookkeeping vouchers' categoryId. Optionally only income or outgo. GET /v1/posting-categories.

tools.name: lexware_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new customer and/or vendor in Lexware Office (Lexware assigns the customer/vendor number). Give company_name for a company OR person_last_name for a private person. One billing and one shipping address, one email and one phone at most. Check lexware_list_contacts first to avoid dupl

tools.name: lexware_create_draft_invoice
tools.description: WRITE: creates an invoice in Lexware Office as a DRAFT (never finalized, numbered or sent; Lexware assigns the number when the user finalizes it in the app). Address it to an existing customer (contact_id) or a one-time address (name + country_code). Prices are EUR. Returns the new id and lexwareApp

tools.name: lexware_create_draft_quotation
tools.description: WRITE: creates a quotation (Angebot) in Lexware Office as a DRAFT (never finalized or sent). Address it to an existing customer (contact_id) or a one-time address (name + country_code). Prices are EUR. Returns the new id and lexwareAppUrl to review and finalize it in Lexware Office. POST /v1/quotati

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lexware_list_contacts, lexware_get_contact, lexware_create_contact · Private data: lexware_get_profile, lexware_list_contacts, lexware_list_vouchers, lexware_get_bookkeeping_voucher, lexware_get_contact, lexware_list_posting_categories, lexware_create_contact · Public sink: lexware_list_contacts, lexware_create_contact, lexware_create_draft_invoice, lexware_create_draft_quotation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lexware_list_contacts, lexware_get_contact, lexware_create_contact · Private data: lexware_get_profile, lexware_list_contacts, lexware_list_vouchers, lexware_get_bookkeeping_voucher, lexware_get_contact, lexware_list_posting_categories, lexware_create_contact · Public sink: lexware_list_contacts, lexware_create_contact, lexware_create_draft_invoice, lexware_create_draft_quotation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
